step_by_step_reasoning: The visual diagram and transcript describe Pushpay's monolith decomposition strategy. 1. The original legacy monolith GIVING (.NET on Windows) connects to a SQL SERVER database. 2. Pushpay extracted identity microservices into Amazon ECS running .NET Core on Alpine Linux with GraphQL APIs. 3. Both GIVING and APPS (Node platform) invoke identity actions on ECS. 4. ECS stores event-sourced user data into Amazon DynamoDB and publishes full event payloads onto Amazon Kinesis. 5. Kinesis streams events back to GIVING to maintain state synchronization and checks-and-balances with the legacy monolith. 6. AWS X-Ray is integrated for distributed tracing across the microservices architecture.
